title: Instrumentation of the boys' band, no titles, all white
summary: The first band had piccolo, clarinet, trombone, cornet, alto, tuba, baritone and drums, made up tunes with no names, and was all white; Laine knows of no earlier ragtime band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Let's see, what kind of instruments did y'all have for that? Just drums and piccolos? Yes, we had one piccolo. One piccolo.
One piccolo player. And we had clarinet. Clarinet. Trombone. Trombone. Carnet. Alto. Tuba. Tuba. And baritone. Of course, drums, of course. And one piccolo.

One piccolo. Now that again was when you were 15 years old. That was around 15 years old. Yeah. I'll be there. Yes. Mm-hmm. Yes. And none of your music had any name to it. You didn't play any, you didn't know the name of any of the songs you played? Never knew the name. The whole thing was just out of your head.

That's right. That's right. We make up that stuff. We tell you a whole lot of stuff. Just like if we were playing it for years, we'd make it up. Yeah. And we'd fight it out and fight it out until we got some kind of time out of it. Good time out of it, you know. Regular dancing time. For a dance. Perfect. And for a march, had a different time for a march.

Were your boys in your band, when you were 15, playing this political meeting, were your boys white or were they colored or were they both? Oh, I never had no colored. All white. All white. I see. Were there any colored bands playing that kind of music then? Not that I know of. Is that right? Not that I know of. As far as you know, the first band that was playing this ragtime was white. No. Is that right?

The first one that I remember was me to come out on the street and play that, play that stuff. But I don't remember any other band. Is that right? No. I don't remember any other band playing that stuff.
